shots.what: hook: starry night, the patchwork balloon with its burner glow glides over the border strip (fence + watchtower far below)
close on the envelope: umbrella-silk band (f113), tent-nylon band (f149), slow pan up
border by day: double fence, watchtower, soldier with binoculars; the barrier slams down on 'dicht'
two fathers carry fabric rolls along the village street to their door, glance round, the door opens
sewing room: needle running, mother at the machine, fabric piled to the ceiling
calm glide over the sleepy village at dusk and the dark forest (follow button, lower centre calm)
first attempt in night fog: plain balloon, one family; the fabric soaks dark, it sinks into the trees
down in the clearing just before the fence line; the family sneaks off into the forest
morning: men in grey coats round the crumpled balloon, magnifying glass, notebook; they look round
kitchen: a father looks into the lens and nods; both families nod, the fathers fist-bump
glide past small shop counters: each time one small roll of fabric is bought
the new giant patchwork envelope lies on the meadow and inflates
night take-off: eight people crouch on the tiny platform, the burner roars, the balloon lifts off
watchtower at night: the searchlight swings up, the beam fades far below the balloon
dawn: the balloon comes down softly in a forest clearing, the families stand up and hug
outro: slow rise over the forest and the deflated balloon at sunrise (logo + button overlay)
